posts.subject: Climb server
posts.bodyHtml: in the climb server (5.39.97.130:26662) the !sinfo is not working when u write !sinfo it just open and close instantly.Can anyone do something about this because i want to check what !sinfo is about.
I think Sky will fix this. The command !sinfo shows which Stammrank you are and which Features you get through thr rank.
